commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle and signals a foul after Johan Mojica (Mallorca) brought his opponent down. Getafe have a free kick.
90+2' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but Lucas Bergstrom comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to substitute Diego Rico and he is replaced by Allan Nyom (Getafe).

89' Diego Rico (Getafe) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed low towards the middle of the goal, but Lucas Bergstrom reads it well and makes a comfortable save.
88' That will be all from Vedat Muriqi who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
86' A lofted cross from Diego Rico (Getafe) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
83' The attendance is 17507.
83' The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
82' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) replaces Sergi Darder.
81' A substitution has been made. Mateo Joseph goes off and Takuma Asano (Mallorca) comes on.
80' Luis Milla (Getafe) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

79' Luis Milla (Getafe) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball into roof of the net, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players. Getafe have a corner.
78' CHANCE! Juanmi (Getafe) receives a brilliant pass and finds himself one-on-one with Lucas Bergstrom, who reacts superbly to stop him.
76' It is time for a substitution. Djene (Getafe) is on for Abdel Abqar.
75' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Alex Sancris is replaced by Abu Kamara (Getafe).
75' Substitution. Juanmi (Getafe) in, Mario Martin out.
73' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is obviously very disappointed with his shot from the rebound. He aims exactly at the goalkeeper's gloves. This should have been an easy goal!
71' Diego Rico (Getafe) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
69' Some neat passing and movement from Mallorca as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
67' Here is a change. Adrian Liso is going off and Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Coba da Costa (Getafe).
65' Mario Martin (Getafe) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
63' That's the end of the game for Jan Virgili, who is replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.
62' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
61' Getafe win a corner.
60' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley well wide of the left post.
59' None of the Getafe players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
59' Adrian Liso (Getafe) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Getafe will take a corner.
58' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle after Samu Costa (Mallorca) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Getafe have been awarded a free kick.
57' Getafe have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
56' Lucas Bergstrom makes a good save! Alex Sancris (Getafe) easily weaves through the defence and fires in from long range. His shot goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper!
55' Adrian Liso (Getafe) is caught in the offside trap after the defenders step up as one at the very right moment.
53' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
53' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
53' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. Good work from Mallorca as they win a corner.
50' Alex Sancris (Getafe) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
48' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
46' Diego Rico (Getafe) receives a reproachful look from his teammates after he attempted to surprise the goalkeeper with a shot from long distance. The ball flew far wide of the right post.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+2' Luis Milla (Getafe) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
45+2' The corner from Luis Milla (Getafe) is hurriedly cleared.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
44' Nice passing game by Getafe. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
39' The ball is laid off to Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players low towards the middle of the goal and forces Lucas Bergstrom to make a decent save.
39' A quickly taken corner by Getafe.

38' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a clever chip pass, but one of the defending players comes up with a timely interception. The linesman makes the right call and Getafe will have a corner.
35' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle as Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
33' The free kick from long range, taken by Mallorca, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
32' Abdel Abqar (Getafe) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
30' Getafe quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
29' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) rises above the defence and heads a precise cross towards the left post. His effort, however, is blocked by Lucas Bergstrom, who pulls off a stunning save!
25' It's a throw-in for Getafe.
23' Getafe are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
20' The game has begun to heat up. Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
19' Mario Martin (Getafe) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
17' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
14' 1 - 0 Goal! Johan Mojica puts a cross into the box and finds Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:0.
13' Getafe fail to score from a corner as Lucas Bergstrom (Mallorca) leaps to collect the ball.

13' Alex Sancris (Getafe) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Getafe will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
12' Referee Ricardo De Burgos sees the trip by Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
10' Getafe hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
9' The ball goes behind for a corner. Getafe will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
5' The free kick from long range, taken by Mallorca, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
4' Mallorca are awarded a free kick from long range.
2' Getafe are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' The linesman signals a throw-in for Mallorca.
1' The first half has started.
Mallorca will kick the game off.
